'''Kalikori village''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] settlement located on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. An illegal settlement, the village was established by a group of [[Pilgrims]] in defiance of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate's]] refusal to allow them to settle on the planet.

==History==
Named after the [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]] word for "beginning", the settlement of Kalikori village was established around [[3651 BBY]], not long after the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] arrived on their ancestral homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. A group of [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]], their homeworlds devastated in the [[Great Galactic War]], petitioned the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to allow them to establish a colony on the recently rediscovered world. However, the Senate refused their petition, as the planet was largely unexplored and still potentially dangerous. But in defiance of the decree, the Twi'leks established their colony anyway. The colonists landed in a valley in the [[Tythos Ridge]], a mountain range just to the east of the still-under construction [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. There, they established a small camp, which over the next decade developed into a large village.

Located on the edge of the native [[Flesh Raider]]s' territory, the Twi'leks begrudged the Jedi Order who refused to protect them due to the illegality of their settlement. Despite the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council's]] denouncement on their presence, many [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentices would visit the camp to meet with the Twi'lek matriarch.

During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] of the galaxy, Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]] set up a Jedi colony on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] to preserve the Jedi order, many Kalikori Twi'leks joined the Jedi colony.
